title: Boundary Vanishing Orders and Asymptotic Expansions for Planar Harmonic Functions with a Sublinear Robin Condition
summary: We study boundary vanishing orders and asymptotic expansions of planar harmonic functions satisfying the sublinear Robin condition $\partial_νu=λu-|u|^{p-1}u,$ with $λ\geq0$ and $0 m$. Integer critical vanishing orders are excluded if the boundary is $C^1$ with Dini mean oscillation.
